answer_q: What is a dedicated AI development team?
answer: A dedicated AI development team is a group of engineers who work exclusively on one client’s product under a monthly arrangement. Unlike fixed-scope projects, the team works through your roadmap continuously, scaling up or down as priorities change, while the provider handles recruitment, management and quality.
body:
Why businesses choose a dedicated AI team

Experienced AI engineers are hard to find and expensive to hire, and the work often comes in waves. A dedicated team gives you proven people quickly, without recruitment fees, long notice periods or the management overhead of building a team from scratch. You set the priorities; we make sure the team delivers.

It suits businesses that have an AI product or platform with an ongoing roadmap, internal teams that need extra AI expertise, and companies that want to keep building after a fixed-scope project such as an AI app or RAG assistant.

Who is on the team

RoleWhat they do
AI engineerModel selection, prompt and agent design, RAG pipelines, evaluation and cost optimisation
Full-stack developerFrontend, backend, APIs and integrations around the AI features
Delivery leadSprint planning, priorities, reporting and your single point of contact
QA and evaluationTesting, regression checks and AI accuracy scoring
Designer (optional)User experience for AI features, including how users review and correct AI output

Teams usually start with two to four people and scale with your roadmap.

How the engagement works

  1. Free AI audit: we discuss your roadmap, stack and the skills you need.
  2. Team proposal: roles, seniority, start date and a fixed monthly price in AUD.
  3. Onboarding: access, codebase walkthrough, ways of working and first sprint plan, usually within two weeks.
  4. Delivery: fortnightly sprints with demos, written progress reports and a monthly review.
  5. Adjust: scale the team up or down with notice as your priorities change.

How our delivery model works

Crenosoft’s engineering group has delivered more than 150 software and AI projects since 2022. Dedicated teams combine engineers from that wider group with delivery management run from Melbourne, so you get Australian business hours for planning and communication, a local contact who understands your market, and engineering capacity that would be hard to hire quickly on your own. We are open about where each team member is based and how the work is organised.

Quality and accountability

  • Code standards: reviews on every change, automated tests and documented architecture.
  • AI quality: evaluation sets and accuracy tracking for every AI feature, following the testing and monitoring practices in the Government’s Guidance for AI Adoption.
  • Visibility: shared boards, sprint demos and monthly reports on progress, quality and AI usage costs.
  • Continuity: documentation and knowledge sharing so no single person is a point of failure.

Security, IP and compliance

You own all code, prompts, configurations and data. Team members work under confidentiality and IP assignment terms, access is limited to what each role needs, and work happens in your repositories and cloud accounts. Data handling follows the Privacy Act 1988 and the OAIC’s AI product guidance, and we can work within your own security policies and reviews.

Dedicated team vs hiring vs freelancers

Hiring in-houseFreelancersCrenosoft dedicated team
Time to startMonthsDays to weeksUsually within two weeks
AI depthDepends on who you findVaries widelySpecialist AI engineers plus wider team support
ManagementYoursYoursDelivery lead included
FlexibilityLowHigh, less continuityScale monthly with continuity

Not sure you need a full team? Start with a fixed-scope AI development project, or ask our AI consultants to plan your roadmap first.

What a dedicated team typically works on

  • Adding AI features to an existing SaaS product, such as summaries, smart search and drafting assistants
  • Building and improving RAG assistants and AI agents over several releases
  • Reducing AI running costs through better prompts, caching and model routing
  • Maintaining integrations as connected systems and AI models change
  • Running evaluation and monitoring so quality stays high as usage grows

Because the same people stay on your product month after month, they build deep knowledge of your codebase, customers and goals, which shortens every future feature. Teams also bring patterns from other AI projects, so you benefit from lessons already learned elsewhere instead of discovering them the hard way.

Working hours and communication

Your delivery lead works Australian business hours, joins your stand-ups and planning sessions, and is the single point of contact for priorities and escalations. Progress is visible in your own tools, whether that is Jira, Linear, GitHub or Azure DevOps, and every sprint ends with a demo of working software rather than a status update.
faqs: How quickly can a dedicated AI team start?
Most teams start within two weeks of agreeing the proposal, including onboarding to your codebase, tools and ways of working.
How is a dedicated AI team billed?
Teams are billed monthly in AUD based on the roles and seniority agreed. You can scale the team up or down with notice as your roadmap changes.
Who owns the code and IP?
You do. All code, prompts, configurations and data belong to you, and team members work under confidentiality and IP assignment terms.
Can the team work with our in-house developers?
Yes. Many clients use our AI engineers alongside their own team, sharing repositories, sprints and code reviews.
cta_p: Free 30-minute AI audit. We’ll recommend the team shape and start date for your roadmap.
